overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies dehydrated oregano leaves for B2B buyers who need a consistent, practical herb ingredient for seasoning and food production. We work with food manufacturers, seasoning companies, restaurants, distributors, and private label brands. Our oregano leaves are cleaned, dehydrated, sieved, and packed to support repeatable processing and dependable handling across bulk and export orders.

We manage the supply process from sourcing to dispatch with a clear six-step flow: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. Buyers can request standard or custom mesh sizes, packaging formats, samples, and export documentation support. We also handle OEM and private label requirements for bulk and small-format packs.
